segments.prompt: Remove the teapot lid and place it neatly beside the teapot.
Pick up the kettle and position it above the open teapot.
Pour hot water steadily from the kettle into the open teapot.
Stop pouring and return the kettle securely to its original place.
Pick up the lid and place it securely onto the teapot.
Lift the teapot and pour tea carefully into the first cup.
Move to the second cup and pour tea until it is full.
Move to the third cup and pour tea until it is full.
Return the teapot carefully to its original position on the table.
